method.visualSource: Authorized original PDFs and matching source page renders were identified by SHA-256. Every unique context crop was visually inspected with its complete all-row-focus overlay, allowing row-by-row pixel comparison of all90 focus rectangles. Each individual row-overlay PNG was independently hash-verified against the index; individual row overlays were opened for disputed details (including rows42 and89). The original DMG p34 and p27 full-page renders and targeted p36 high-resolution source crop were also inspected.
method.automatedChecks: Verified all 90 row overlay file hashes against the index; verified underlying clean crop bytes against the index crop SHA; verified source-render bytes against sourceRender SHA; verified unique stable record IDs. Hash/geometry checks do not replace pixel judgments.
method.pageExtent: PHB p29/PDF30; DMG pp20,25,26,27,33,35 at corresponding PDF pages 21,26,27,28,34,36.

limitations: Rows 48–64 retain visually matching row-focus pixels but are context-held because the shared p27 crop has a source-image edge defect and omits an applicable Brocade*/Tapestry footnote.

The candidate still has 89 rows outside this review. None of these first90 judgments is transferable to a superseding candidate absent exact per-row/crop/focus/image byte-identity evidence.
This report does not approve any candidate integration, page default, field binding, monetary source coverage or publication.
